interpretation: No new obvious coding loss-of-function candidate emerged under this bounded screen. All12 missense candidates are common public population alleles; none is promoted as a newly found immune-escape mutation. This does not establish functional antigen presentation/interferon response or predict immunotherapy benefit.
limits: One selected coding transcript plus4bp, not all regulatory/structural/epigenetic alterations.
Initial SNV >=10alt reads,>=5% allele fraction; reference alignments, no clinical sensitivity.
Expression is bulk and includes nonmalignant cells.
July pretreatment specimen cannot exclude later treatment-acquired resistance.
No matched normal or clinical pathogenicity adjudication for common polymorphisms.
